required_version: record exact release and git commit at execution; not installed

protocol.routing: propose GlobalRouting static baseline; specify separate dynamic routing protocol and convergence semantics before claiming convergence
protocol.traffic: propose UDP constant-bit-rate endpoint flow; exact rate and payload must be frozen before execution
protocol.faults: schedule one named edge down then optionally up at fixed simulation times; no hidden-state policy oracle
protocol.fairness: identical graph, traffic, failure, timing, seed, monitor rights and budget across comparators

limitations: static global routing does not by itself establish dynamic convergence
software link toggles are not physical restoration
